title: Lelaki Tinggi Segak
genre: Malay bangsawan theatre song (1920s Malay stage operetta with violin and clarinet)
subject: A palm reader under a rain tree beside an old theatre who tells every customer the same line about a tall handsome stranger, until a tall man in a white suit sits down and she has no line left.
caption: Malay bangsawan theatre song, 1920s stage operetta style with a bouncy two-beat march. Violin carrying a light singing melody, clarinet answering in short phrases, upright piano playing offbeat chords, brushed snare drum, double bass walking in two. Live theatre-pit feel, dry room, bright vintage tone. Female vocal, bright mid register, comic stage delivery, clearly sung. 108 BPM, F major. Playful, theatrical, teasing. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No synth, no electric guitar, no trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no modern pop gloss.
lyrics:
[Intro - violin and clarinet, two-beat march]

[Verse 1]
Duduk di bawah pokok hujan
Aku tilik tapak tangan orang
Semua kuberi satu ramalan
Akan datang lelaki tinggi segak

[Pre-Chorus]
Ada yang ketawa, ada yang malu
Semua bayar, semua pulang

[Chorus]
Lelaki tinggi segak, mari mari
Ramalan Mak Tilah tak pernah silap
Lelaki tinggi segak, mari mari
Tapi hari ini kau betul-betul tiba

[Verse 2]
Petang tadi datang seorang tuan
Berbaju putih, kepala hampir cecah dahan
Dia hulur tangan, aku terdiam
Habis stok kata-kata semua

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia kata dia sesat jalan
Mencari panggung lama di sini

[Chorus]
Lelaki tinggi segak, mari mari
Ramalan Mak Tilah, kali ini benar
Lelaki tinggi segak, duduklah dulu
Tak payah bayar, teh pun aku belanja

[Outro - clarinet and violin, curtain-call flourish]
Lelaki tinggi segak, mari mari
Tirai pun turun, tepuk tanganlah
